reading_text.title: Match the photos 1-4 with the messages A-D.
reading_text.full_text:
A: That's a photo of Saoirse Ronan. She's an Irish actor. She's in the film Little Women. I think she's great!
B: I'm from London and my favourite football team is Arsenal. My favourite Arsenal player is Bukayo Saka.
C: Akemi Dawn Bowman is an American writer. Her book Starfish is one of my favourites. I love it!
